Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. NPR's Scott Horsley reports critics have dismissed the move

noting the Fed is supposed to be insulated from political pressure and finding that Trump had not
given Cook an opportunity to defend herself. Now, the president has set up a committee and

Washington. The United Arab Emirates has released new details in its
investigation of a pilot they say tried to hijack a plane full of Israeli passengers.
NPR's Ayyaba Trawi reports the UAE says the pilot wanted to crash the plane into the passenger
terminal of Tel Aviv's airport. The UAE's attorney general says the 29-year-old pilot from Oman
had drifted toward extremist ideologies when he was around 20 years old. They say that's when he
started following online content, glorifying suicide attacks while studying in Melbourne.
According to his confession, the UAE says this content influenced his decision to become a pilot.
The UAE says the pilot used two previous flights to Tel Aviv on Fly Dubai to familiarize himself
with the route before the September 30 attempted hijacking, in which investigators say he claims
to have acted alone. The pilot, who was hired by Fly Dubai in January, used an emergency axe to
attack the captain before the plane's emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Ayyaba Trawi, NPR News,
Dubai. The U.S. stock market finished its record setting week with more gains today. This is NPR.

The group claimed last month that it breached the FBI's jobs portal, obtaining sensitive data on
nearly all employees. Experts warn the breach has alarming national security implications,
potentially exposing agents and their families to extortion and harassment.

Bernadette Green Placentia initially didn't want to report she was raped. She says she didn't want
to think about it. But the Democrats says it was important to speak up on behalf of other
survivors of sexual violence, many of whom, she says, have reached out to her this week.
Still, Green Placentia says the publicity has been difficult.
My world exploded again and now it's kind of come back. And with that is, you know,
